atoms.text: Here is a table which shows the population of Greater London from 1980 to 2020. Use the data in this table to plot and draw your own line graph.

hint.text: As we use line graphs to visualise changes and trends, it is okay if the y-axis doesn’t start at 0. It is more important that the data and information is easy to read.

instruction.text: Look at the table and drag the points to the correct places on the graph.
Draw the line to join up the data you have plotted on the graph.
Answer the questions about the graph you just constructed.

atoms.a: In how many decades was the population at 6.8 million?
In how many decades did the population rise?
Approximately how many million people lived in London in 1995? Give your answer to 1 decimal place.
